Dated assay transfer exposes stage-specific prediction failures. | Establish a consequential gain against an adequately specified rival with matched evidence and assumptions. Neither the reduced baselines nor disagreement between unvalidated velocity approximations establishes superior prediction. Measure sorting and descendants to decide the physical correspondence. Broad empirical superiority remains unestablished. |

entry_before.title_zh: 生成对选择的递归影响
entry_before.title_en: Recursive influence of generation on selection
entry_before.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。
entry_before.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit.
entry_before.scope_zh: 保留16/26、19/41、7/13及6/6定理/审计与反例；本轮无新定理。54段视频/18项技术重复、33/190敏感性、3,808记录/3,600联系及42/72对7/72保持范围；3,424项预测及139分组/485行核验保留。新核对八项生长及两项竞争摘要，不能转作周期概率。初始未形成与后来失效须区分；联合校准、广泛比较与支持更新仍开放。
entry_before.scope_en: Preserves 16/26, 19/41, 7/13 and 6/6 theorem/audit results and counterexamples; no new theorem. The 54 videos/18 technical replicates, 33/190 sensitivity, 3,808 records/3,600 links, 42/72 versus 7/72, 3,424 forecasts and 139-cohort/485-row checks retain their scopes. Eight growth and two competition summaries cannot become cycle probabilities. Initial absence versus later loss, joint calibration, broad comparison and support renewal remain open.

Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants.
